items.title: User Interview Insights - Creator Tools
items.content:
From 5 user interviews:
- Users want faster capture, not richer editing
- Voice notes are underused but loved when tried
- Smart organization is the #1 requested feature
- Most users have 50-200 cards

items.title: Technical Architecture Decisions
items.content:
Key decisions:
1. Supabase over Firebase (Postgres, RLS, better DX)
2. Tiptap over ProseMirror directly (React bindings)
3. Vite over Next.js for now (SPA is sufficient)
4. localStorage for MVP, Supabase for cloud sync
items.summary: Core technical architecture choices for Lovcore.
